column2: 10.6 INTEGER UNIT INSTRUCTION TIMINGS: DIVS.W, DIVU.W* | DIVS.L, DIVU.L, DIVSL.L, DIVUL.L* | JMP
column6: *This instruction interlocks the <ea> calculate and execute stages. Execution time for a DIV/0 exception taken and exception processing is approximately 16 + <ea> calculate clocks. For example, DIV.W #0,Dn takes approximately 24 clocks in both the <ea> calculate and execute times to execute the divide instruction, perform exception stacking, fetch the exception vector, and prefetch the next instruction.
